title: User-Call-Settings
description: The object that defines the user's call settings

incoming.description: A collection of properties that define how incoming calls to the user should be handled.

second_action.description: The action to take if the call is not handled by the destination defined in the `first_action`.

action.description: The action to take when an incoming call reaches the user.

to.description: The type of function on which the action is to be taken.

first_action.description: Defines how an incoming call to the user should be handled.

show.description: The caller ID shown when you receive an incoming call.

action.description: The action to take when an incoming call reaches the user.

ring_time.description: The number of seconds that the incoming call should ring. Only applies when the action is `ring` or `forward`.

to.description: The type of function on which the action is to be taken.

id.description: The unique id of the destination to which the incoming call should be sent.

standard_action.description: Specifies how WebRTC calls (i.e. calls made using our apps) are handled.

ring_time.description: The number of seconds the call should ring before disconnecting.

to.description: The destination where the call should connect.

outgoing.description: A collection of properties that control how outgoing calls are handled. At the moment it is only possible to select the caller ID shown to the person you call.

show.description: The caller-id shown when a user makes an outgoing call. Accepts `auto`, `none` or an eligible Sonetel number.

callthru-pin.description: Deprecated property used for our old manual Call Thru service.
